_status: v2 DRAFT for the user's review: v1 (from the four transcripts plus the user's niche / no-dumper rules) tightened with a persistence study: the traits that predicted a wallet still winning a week later (win rate, green days, spread-out profit), measured on week 1 -> week 2 of the older half only, so the forward test stays honest. See PLAN.md.

pool._about: Who gets looked at. Cheap checks on a wallet's GMGN profile before any history is pulled.

wallet._about: Stage 1, from the wallet's own trades: copyable style (holds, entry size) and the traits that persisted week to week (win rate, green days, profit not from one trade).

copy._about: Stage 2, a pass/fail copyability check with the bot's real fees and guards (past copy profit did not predict future copy profit, so it is not used for ranking). Fomo traders go on copyfomo, everyone else on GMGN.

picks._about: Ranked by persistence: win rate x green-day share x sample size. At most 2 well-known wallets, and one wallet per trader: two wallets that share most of their coins and repeatedly buy within a minute of each other count as one trader (only the best-ranked is kept).

copyfomo._about: Telegram bot copying fomo traders (SOL + Robinhood chain + Base + BNB). 2% per buy and per sell (docs, hidden since 2026-09-08: confirm on the bot's confirmation screen), network cost passed through, copies from $3.

gmgn._about: GMGN copy trade: any Solana wallet, max 10. 1% per buy and per sell plus the priority fee you set. User setup ($65 start): $3 per copy, 0.0003 SOL priority (~$0.036). At this size every 0.0001 SOL of priority fee costs ~0.4% per side. No max-chase guard; its min copy amount stands in for copyfomo's minimum trade.
